description: The most comprehensive food safety MCP server. 5 tools: check any food additive (E-number, CAS, name), scan full ingredient lists for risks, search by category/concern, look up nutritional profiles of 4,624 Israeli foods, and check pesticide residue limits on crops. Data: 6,450+ additives with PubChem molecular data, 6,563 JECFA ADI evaluations, 5,251 EFSA toxicology records, 77,278 synonyms, 4,624 MOH nutrition profiles, 3,708 pesticide MRLs, 1,290 FDA GRAS notices, Israeli regulatory status, dietary flags (vegan/halal/kosher). Built by Two Halves — twohalves.ai
